THE SHARED OUTBOUND SPINE - read this first

Trade, Non-trade and STO are three equally important business pillars. They share one outbound spine: a sales order (Trade, Non-trade) or a stock transport order (STO) leads to Create DI, then stock and batch selection, then shipment and freight, then goods issue, then billing, then the statutory documents.

API-02, API-03, API-04, API-05, API-06, API-07 and API-12 sit on that shared spine and serve all three pillars. API-08, API-09, API-10 and API-11 are STO-specific. API-01 is the inbound side - receiving stock into a depot - and is not one of the three outbound pillars.

SCOPE CORRECTION: earlier drafts of v1.8 read as though STO were the default architecture. It is not. STO is simply the first pillar traced end to end in QS4, because it was the flow available there. Every ZP06, ZNL, ZSTO and individual document number in this workbook is stock transfer evidence and must never be copied onto Trade or Non-trade.

Three words are used throughout for pillar behaviour. CONFIRMED means we know it. STO-OBSERVED means we saw it on a stock transfer document and it may not hold for Trade or Non-trade. OPEN means nobody has checked. An OPEN cell is not a small cell - it means unknown, not simple.
Never copy an STO-OBSERVED value into an OPEN cell. ZP06, ZNL, ZSTO, ZSTON, 641 and every document number in this workbook are stock transfer values.
COLUMN CONVENTION - read this before reading any request or response table

The Mandatory column answers ONE question: is this field required on the call? Permitted values are Yes / No / Conditional / Derived / Defaulted / Assertion only / OPEN. It NEVER carries an evidence status.

HOW TO DEFEND A SINGLE FIELD - the five evidence levels
Every request or response property in this workbook carries FIVE separable claims. They have different evidence and must not be collapsed into one word.
LEVEL 1 - the property EXISTS: name, EDM type, precision, scale, max length. PROVEN from the local SEGW design-time extracts.
LEVEL 2 - the DDIC FIELD behind it. PROVEN - the extracts carry an ABAP_FIELD column per property.

LEVEL 3 - its ROLE: IS_KEY, CREATABLE, UPDATABLE, NULLABLE, FILTERABLE, SORTABLE, UNIT_PROPERTY. PARTIAL - see the mining-pass result below. IS_KEY is captured everywhere; the creatable/updatable/filterable/sortable flags are captured ONLY for the delivery family. A BLANK flag means NOT CAPTURED, never false.
LEVEL 4 - the BUSINESS VALUE is correct (ZP06, ZNL, movement 101, ZSTO). PROVEN by read-only QS4 table observation, subject to the sample-size caveat above.
LEVEL 5 - SAP ACCEPTS IT IN A LIVE CALL. NOT PROVEN for any API. This requires Gateway activation.

Wherever this workbook says RUNTIME-UNPROVEN it means LEVEL 5 ONLY. Levels 1 to 4 are evidenced. Earlier drafts of this workbook wrongly implied that property names were vendor documentation - they are local extracts from QS4 client 700.
